app.name: LyricSync Studio
app.tagline: Sync your lyrics. Create stunning visuals.
app.taglineAlt: Synchronize lyrics to music with precision

home.noProjectsDescription: Create your first project to start syncing lyrics to music.
home.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this project?

setup.uploadAudioDesc: Drag and drop or click to upload an audio file

mode.syncing: Syncing — tap Space for each line

calibration.title: Latency Calibration
calibration.description: Tap Space along with the metronome beat. This helps compensate for your reaction time and audio latency.

export.title: Export
export.videoDescription: Export a high-definition 9:16 video with animated typography, ready for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.
export.lrcDescription: Standard lyric file format compatible with music players and platforms.
export.videoReadyDesc: Preview the generated video below or download it directly to your device.
export.previewPlaceholderDesc: Configure options on the right and click 'Generate MP4 Video' to create your 9:16 reel.

legal.title: Before you start
legal.description: LyricSync Studio processes all audio and lyrics locally in your browser. No data is sent to any server.
legal.agreement: By using this tool, you confirm that you have the necessary rights to the audio and lyrics you process.
legal.privacy: Your files never leave your browser.

storage.description: Your browser's storage may be limited. We recommend exporting a backup to avoid losing your work.
